name: rtl-hebrew
description: Draws Hebrew paragraphs of the conversation right-to-left and flush right, with headings, lists and emphasis kept; code blocks, tables and Latin paragraphs stay as they are. /rtl toggles it.

mode.title: Which paragraphs read right-to-left
mode.description: auto: paragraphs with more Hebrew than Latin letters. always: every paragraph that has any Hebrew in it. off: draw nothing differently.

userMessages.title: Also your own prompts
userMessages.description: Draw the prompts you typed right-to-left too, not only Claude's replies.
